name: Fire Escape
hint: Up one floor at a time. Whoever is left behind gets a spring.
why4: Two must end up on the top floor to hold the 2-plate that unlids the springs, and each floor up costs one thrower left behind; with three, only one reaches the top.
solution: P4 hops over the key at x=7 and stands at x=13 (edge of the 2-wide gap at x=14-15); P3 hops the key too and stands beside P4. P4 grabs P3 and throws right onto tier 1 (height 3, face x=16).
P2 picks up the key at x=7 and is thrown up to tier 1 by P4 too (a friend carrying the key can be thrown).
On tier 1, P3 stands at x=22 (edge of the gap at x=23-24), grabs P2 and throws right onto tier 2 (3 higher, face x=25). P4 throws P1 up to tier 1 and P3 throws P1 up to tier 2.
P2 and P1 stand on the plate at x=29-30 (2/2): both flush lids A open, showing springs one tile down at x=12 and x=21.
P4 steps into the hole at x=12, lands on the spring and steers right onto tier 1 (peak 4.5 above the floor), then steps into the hole at x=21 and steers right onto tier 2.
P3 steps into the hole at x=21 and steers onto tier 2.
P2 opens the door at x=37; all four press Down.
Recovery: anyone falling in a gap respawns at the start; while two hold the plate they come back up by the springs.
